purpose: Recognize ultrasound RECT_DEPTH value and bounding box from a folder of images using OCR, classical rules, folder consistency, and a tabular ranker prior.

required_inputs.folder: Configuration folder or image folder. If image_samples exists it is used.
required_inputs.output_dir: Directory where CSV and summary files are written.

optional_inputs.fss: Optional .fss used for RECT_ECHO and expected depth snapping.
optional_inputs.context_json: Optional pipeline JSON containing vendor/probe predictions.
optional_inputs.expected_depths: Comma/space separated expected depth values in mm.
optional_inputs.max_images: Default 80. Use 0 for full-folder production processing.

fields.ocr_text: Normalized OCR text used for the selected candidate.
fields.best_scale_value_mm: Diagnostic best scale value in mm.
fields.candidates: Number of candidates generated for the image.

status_policy.review: Show in review or handle with conservative fallback.
status_policy.reject: Do not emit an automatic depth.

modes.direct_label: Depth value in UI text, introduced by Depth/D/P/R or stable unit evidence.
modes.scale: Depth inferred from the maximum value on the visual scale.
modes.numeric_accessory: Numeric candidate without enough direct or scale evidence; normally not selected unless promoted by folder rules.

folder_strategies.direct_label_unit_stable: Stable varying D/P/R/Depth + value + cm/mm across the folder.
folder_strategies.direct_label_d_stable: Stable varying D + value without unit across the folder.
folder_strategies.direct_left_context_stable: Target letter is a separate OCR token left of the numeric value.
folder_strategies.direct_interface_unit_stable: Stable value + cm/mm in UI, marker missing or fused.
folder_strategies.hitachi_bottom_direct_stable: Hitachi/Arietta bottom UI line with R/P/D + value.
folder_strategies.scale_from_variable_scale: Direct candidate is constant but scale maximum varies.
folder_strategies.scale_unit_required: Scale lane with repeated cm/mm unit evidence.
folder_strategies.scale_endpoint_lane: Stable scale endpoint lane; zero endpoint is never selected.

core_rules: A depth must contain a numeric value.
0 and 0.0 are never valid depth values.
Allowed suffixes are cm, mm, or no suffix.
If there is no cm/mm suffix, the bounding box must stop after the number.
After the number no letters are allowed except cm/mm.
D/P/R are valid only as isolated target letters immediately left of the value.
Depth may appear left of or above the number.
Direct UI label wins over scale when it is coherent and variable across the folder.
If direct value is constant while scale varies, scale can become the folder strategy.
Scale fallback selects the maximum value at one endpoint, opposite the zero endpoint when zero is visible.
Scale is searched primarily on the right side; left is a rare fallback.
Hz, MHz, dB, FR, 2D, Print, and X3-like markers are not depth.
